Aasimar.description: Aasimar bear within their souls the light of the heavens, granting them celestial power and a touch of the divine.

Dragonborn.description: Born of dragons, dragonborn walk proudly through a world that greets them with fearful incomprehension.

Drow.description: Drow are elves of the Underdark, known for their innate magic and superior darkvision.

Dwarf.description: Dwarves are solidly built, with broad shoulders and thick frames. They are known for their resilience, craftsmanship, and connection to stone.

Forest Gnome.description: As a forest gnome, you have a natural knack for illusion and an inherent connection to small beasts.

Goliath.description: Goliaths are towering, powerful people descended from giants, driven by competition and a desire to prove themselves.

Halfling.description: Halflings are small, practical folk who enjoy the comforts of home but can rise to remarkable bravery when called upon.

High Elf.description: As a high elf, you have a keen mind and a mastery of at least the basics of magic.

Human.description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. Whatever drives them, humans are the innovators, the achievers, and the pioneers of the worlds.

Orc.description: Orcs are hardy, powerful people who trace their creation to Gruumsh. They are known for their endurance and ferocity.

Rock Gnome.description: As a rock gnome, you have a natural inventiveness and hardiness beyond that of other gnomes.

Tiefling.description: Tieflings are derived from human bloodlines touched by the Lower Planes, bearing an infernal, abyssal, or chthonic legacy.

Tiefling (Abyssal).description: Your fiendish legacy connects you to the Abyss, granting poison resistance and toxic spellcasting.

Tiefling (Chthonic).description: Your fiendish legacy connects you to the Underdark's deepest reaches, granting necrotic resistance and deathly spellcasting.

Tiefling (Infernal).description: Your fiendish legacy connects you to the Nine Hells, granting fire resistance and infernal spellcasting.

Wood Elf.description: As a wood elf, you have keen senses and intuition, and your fleet feet carry you quickly and stealthily through your native forests.
